items.name: Minnesota Wild Rice
items.description: Hand-harvested wild rice from northern Minnesota lakes, sold by the pound. To order, open an issue with the quantity in pounds, the date you need it delivered, and the delivery location. We confirm price and availability within 5 business days. Every lot includes the farm of origin and harvest date.
